verdict.comment: This looks another fair opportunity for the in-form CONCERT BOY, who has already won twice here this year. Sir Maxi is second pick.

comments.americanstar: Off since October, but won Class 5 handicap at Chester (turf) last summer; not ruled out
comments.concertboy: Three course wins, two of them this year; placed last two goes; leading claims
comments.drakeholes: Four-time C&D winner, the most recent coming in November, but not so good more recently
comments.kalganov: Won C&D Class 5 in December 2023; has been struggling but has had a breathing operation
comments.keepmestable: Three C&D wins, latest in September, but finished last under these conditions latest
comments.oddsockshavana: Five course wins; close second to Pallas Lord in 1m handicap here on Tuesday
comments.pallaslord: Gained an eighth course win in 1m Class 6 handicap here on Tuesday; 4lb penalty
comments.rory: Three course wins over 5f-6f; has won over easier 7f than this; needs to up recent level
comments.sirmaxi: Has won here (7f/6f) twice, the most recent coming in Class 6 in January; now blinkered

races.raceComment: concertboy is marginally preferred with a score of 58.0%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over pallaslord. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.title: BetMGM: It's Showtime Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Two hard-to-weigh-up newcomers, but NOBLE TESTIMONY is the clear pick of those with form, setting a fair standard.

comments.auroramajesty: Has a decent pedigree; newcomer to take seriously
comments.nobletestimony: Runner-up in similar races over 7f-1m here on first two starts; the form pick by some way
comments.onemorebottle: Well beaten in bumpers and on recent Flat debut over 1m here (100-1)
comments.symphonyssong: 46,000gns yearling with a decent pedigree; another newcomer to take seriously
comments.wyldbill: Hard to fancy on what he's shown on the Flat and, more recently, over hurdles; new trainer

comments.shaz: Has been off for over a year and looks a doubtful stayer; debut for new trainer
comments.skilledwarrior: Runner-up in 1m2f Class 6 here off 249-day absence latest; player if backing that up

verdict.comment: Cases to be made for most of these and perhaps ARLINGTON, a two-time C&D winner and runner-up last week, is the answer.

comments.arlington: Two-time C&D winner and runner-up under these conditions last week; contender
comments.athollblairboy: Veteran 11-time course winner; 1l behind Arlington over C&D last week; chance
comments.cuan: Held in similar race at Wolverhampton on handicap debut, but she'd been off for 237 days
comments.cubanista: 1-36 overall, including 0-11 on AW, and absent since October, but has been placed over C&D
comments.doontheglen: 0-23 but has finished runner-up over C&D and filled the same spot at Southwell latest
comments.hurstwood: Has won over C&D and some okay form this year before not-so-good run latest; not ruled out
comments.korroor: Sole win gained over 7f here in 2023; hard to recommend on more recent form
comments.midnightattheoasis: Placed in Class 6 AW events elsewhere last two starts including at Wolverhampton on Monday
comments.raftup: Back-to-form winner of similar race over C&D with hood added last week; penalised
comments.shesashambles: Below form in similar race over C&D latest, but has placed form a few times here
comments.wildmountain: Some creditable form at Dundalk recently; another who has a shot

races.raceComment: raftup is marginally preferred with a score of 58.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over arlington. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
